objective: Highest single-model accuracy subject to T4 16 GiB deployment; foundation before ensembles or distillation
preflight_caveats: H200, bfloat16, repeated training images, synthetic regression objective and six optimizer steps only
GPU timings exclude the production data loader; gradient-finiteness checks are included
Probe head is mean pooling + LayerNorm + Linear128/GELU/Linear3; not the final tuned model
Batch/checkpoint/layout alternatives are combined interventions, not isolated speed ablations
ConvNeXt reference uses the historical external ImageNet22k->ImageNet1k weights, not DINOv3 ConvNeXt weights
